confirmedIssues: EV-05-001 (blocking): strict lower-band readiness still diverges from strict semantic-accounting selection. `prepareAsyncThread` only blocks missing lower-band text in `src/thread/async-thread/services/async-thread-run-service.ts:884-911`, while its chunk selection planning accepts `resolveChunkSemanticArtifactAccounting(..., policyMode: "prepare")` in `src/thread/async-thread/services/async-thread-run-service.ts:363-393`. `buildDraftThreadView` resolves the same semantic accounting under the caller mode and stops selecting chunks when strict accounting is unavailable in `src/thread-view/services/thread-view-builder.ts:308-342` and `:523-555`. I reproduced the mismatch on a canonical semantic thread: `prepareAsyncThread(mode:"strict")` returned `lowerBandReady: true` with no blockers, while `buildDraftThreadView(mode:"strict")` returned `status: "ready"` with both `detailedSelected` and `briefSelected` empty.

EV-05-005 (nonblocking): compaction freshness reporting still treats any ready semantic artifact as fresh. `inspectLowerBandFreshness` returns `status: "fresh"` for every ready artifact without checking provenance or prepare-time regeneration in `src/workbench/services/compaction-report-service.ts:143-162`, and `tests/workbench/compaction-report-service.test.ts:236-277` still asserts `fresh` for degraded-count semantic artifacts, so the report cannot distinguish genuinely fresh output from ready-but-stale/regenerated output.
disputedOrUnconfirmedIssues: EV-05-002 and EV-05-003 are no longer supported by current evidence: `npm run verify-all` passed in this workspace on May 18, 2026, including 491 service tests, 15 general E2E tests, and all 3 long-thread real PI execution tests.
result.readinessAssessment: Closeout is still blocked. The gate health concerns from the earlier review are cleared, but the main production-path defect remains: strict readiness and strict projection building still disagree about whether semantic lower-band state is actually usable, so smart compact can report a thread as strict-ready while emitting no detailed/brief lower-band selections.
result.recommendedNextStep: Make strict readiness and strict build use the same semantic-accounting contract for semantic lower-band chunks, then add a regression test that exercises the reproduced canonical-semantic case (`prepareAsyncThread(mode:"strict")` plus `buildDraftThreadView(mode:"strict")`). After that, tighten compaction freshness reporting so it can distinguish `fresh`, `regenerated_during_prepare`, and `blocked_or_stale`, and rerun `npm run verify-all`.
